The rules explicitly say: "Number/year format differences that clearly denote the same certificate = same-entity with the register's canonical form." Since the document is the legal instrument, its full legal name "PULS ELEKTRONIK SISTEMLERI MAK.SAN. IC VE DIS TIC. LTD. STI." is the better fused value. Also "ELEKTRONIK" matches the actual Turkish spelling.

I'll go with same-entity, best_value = document's full name, why: only spelling drift (C→K) plus legal suffix expansion, same company; the certificate carries the full legal name.
